title: Alliance Home Entertainment Appoints Rozita Tolouey Group Senior Vice President, Studio Strategy & Marketing

body_markdown:
PLANTATION, Fla., Nov. 17, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — Alliance Entertainment Holding Corporation (Nasdaq: AENT), an entertainment commerce and collectibles platform generating more than $1 billion in annual revenue and serving more than 35,000 retail and e-commerce storefronts, today announced the appointment of Rozita Tolouey as Group Senior Vice President, Studio Strategy & Marketing of its Alliance Home Entertainment (AHE) division, adding an accomplished entertainment executive with extensive experience in studio marketing, franchise development and strategic partnerships to the company’s leadership team.


Rozita Tolouey brings more than two decades of experience across film, home entertainment and video games, including nearly 13 years at Paramount Pictures, where she served as Senior Vice President of Home Entertainment Marketing. During her tenure, she developed marketing strategies for some of the entertainment industry’s most recognizable franchises, including *Mission: Impossible, Transformers, Star Trek, Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles, SpongeBob SquarePants* and *G.I. Joe* , alongside Marvel’s Iron Man, Iron Man 2, Thor and Captain America: The First Avenger.


Her experience also encompassed film releases and acquired and independently produced content, including *Boyhood, Paranormal Activity* and *Nebraska* . She also led the relaunch of Paramount’s home entertainment acquisitions business.


Her responsibilities spanned audience development, brand positioning, marketing strategy and campaign execution across new releases, catalog and acquired content. She worked closely with major retailers, including Walmart and Amazon, on commercial positioning, pricing, promotional strategies and product offerings. That breadth of experience across audiences, content categories and retail channels is particularly relevant as physical entertainment increasingly embraces 4K UHD, SteelBooks, limited editions and collector-focused products.


More recently, Rozita Tolouey established the Business Development & Strategic Partnerships function at Tencent Games in North America, extending her experience into building commercial relationships, strategic alliances and new business opportunities.


**Building on AHE’s Home Entertainment Platform**


AHE continues to build on its position as a leading home entertainment distribution and licensing partner, combining distribution scale, operational execution, retail expertise and deep studio partnerships to create new opportunities for content owners and consumers.


The company’s strategy encompasses major studio releases, catalog and deep-catalog libraries, independent films, genre entertainment and specialist collector markets. Across these categories, AHE sees continued opportunities to create value through disciplined execution, deeper consumer understanding, differentiated products and new approaches to bringing entertainment to market.


These opportunities reflect the enduring appeal of physical entertainment to consumers seeking ownership, quality, and collectible experiences. They also offer content owners new ways to extend the commercial life of their intellectual property, reach established and emerging audiences, and generate incremental value from film and television libraries.


**In her new role, Rozita Tolouey will lead the strategic development of AHE’s studio partnerships, working collaboratively across the organization to identify growth opportunities, strengthen audience engagement, and develop marketing and product strategies tailored to the distinct priorities of each content owner.**


“Our ambition is to be more than an exceptionally capable distribution partner. We want to help content owners build audiences, develop differentiated products and unlock greater long-term value from their film and television properties,” said Robert Oram, EVP of Alliance Home Entertainment. “Rozita brings precisely the experience, creativity and commercial understanding to help us deliver on that ambition, whether we’re working with major studios, independent filmmakers or specialist content owners.”


Rozita Tolouey sees significant opportunity in the continued evolution of physical entertainment and AHE’s ability to help partners connect content with audiences.


“Throughout my career, I’ve been passionate about connecting great entertainment with audiences in ways that create lasting value,” said Rozita Tolouey. “What excites me about AHE is the opportunity to do that across an incredibly diverse portfolio of content and partners, each with different audiences, priorities and opportunities.”


“Physical entertainment is an especially exciting space today because consumers are showing such enthusiasm for premium formats, collectible editions and the experience of owning the content they love. I’m looking forward to working closely with our partners to understand what makes their content and audiences distinctive, develop ideas that create demand and find new ways to generate incremental commercial value.”


**About Alliance Entertainment**


Alliance Entertainment (NASDAQ: AENT) is a premier distributor and fulfillment partner for the entertainment and pop culture collectibles industry. With more than 340,000 unique in-stock SKUs – including over 57,300 exclusive titles across compact discs, vinyl LPs, DVDs, Blu-rays, and video games – Alliance offers the largest selection of physical media in the market. Our vast catalog also includes licensed merchandise, toys, retro gaming products, and collectibles, serving over 35,000 retail locations and powering e-commerce fulfillment for leading retailers. Alliance also owns and operates proprietary collectibles brands, including Handmade by Robots™, a stylized vinyl figure line featuring licensed characters from leading entertainment franchises, and Alliance Authentic™, a premium platform for authentic, certified, and individually numbered entertainment collectibles. In addition, Alliance operates Endstate Authentic, a dedicated NFC-enabled authentication and digital product identity platform supporting authenticated collectibles, resale, and brand protection. Leveraging decades of operational expertise, exclusive sourcing relationships, and a capital-light, scalable infrastructure, Alliance connects fans and collectors to the products, franchises, and experiences they value across formats and generations.
